entries.witness: Acts 2:30 "that of the fruit of his loins, according to the flesh, he would raise up Christ to sit on his throne"
entries.takes: So David's loins reach the child through the line Luke 3:31 gives, without the husband being the begetter.
layer_lines: [L1] Acts 2:30: "Therefore being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him, that of the fruit of his loins, according to the flesh, he would raise up Christ to sit on his throne;"

[L3] Hebrews 7:9: "And as I may so say, Levi also, who receiveth tithes, payed tithes in Abraham."
[L3] Hebrews 7:10: "For he was yet in the loins of his father, when Melchisedec met him."

entries.witness: Matthew 1:20 "fear not to take unto thee Mary thy wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Ghost"
entries.takes: The "fear" is of taking her.
layer_lines: [L1] Matthew 1:20: "But while he thought on these things, behold, the angel of the Lord appeared unto him in a dream, saying, Joseph, thou son of David, fear not to take unto thee Mary thy wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Ghost. [conceived: Gr. begotten]"
[L2] phobeō (G5399): "to be alarmed". gar (G1063): "assigning a reason".
[L3] Matthew 1:18: "Now the birth of Jesus Christ was on this wise: When as his mother Mary was espoused to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Ghost."

entries.witness: Mark 7:8 "ye hold the tradition of men, [as] the washing of pots and cups"
entries.takes: The matter of Mark 7:8-9 is washings and the keeping of tradition, and that is the matter it states.

entries.witness: Hebrews 7:14 "For [it is] evident that our Lord sprang out of Juda"
entries.takes: It is plain that he sprang out of Juda because Matthew 1:16 gives the house by Joseph and Luke 3:31 gives the seed by the woman.
layer_lines: [L1] Hebrews 7:14: "For [it is] evident that our Lord sprang out of Juda; of which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priesthood."

entries.witness: Haggai 2:23 "and will make thee as a signet: for I have chosen thee"
entries.takes: Haggai gives the signet to Zerubbabel, called "governor of Judah", and that is the office Haggai names.

[L2] zera' (H2233, seed) stands in Jeremiah 22:30, and Matthew 1:12 shows Salathiel as Jechonias's begotten son.

entries.takes: What is chosen is Zerubbabel himself, "my servant", and the office named is "governor", not one sitting upon the throne.
